description: This Java class implements the SmsReadPlatformService interface for reading SMS message data from a database. It provides methods to retrieve all SMS messages, retrieve specific messages by ID, and filter messages based on status, campaign, date, and pagination parameters. It uses JDBC templates, SQL generators, and mapping logic to fetch and convert database rows into SmsData objects.

classes.name: SmsMapper
classes.description: A private static class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to SmsData objects. It constructs SQL schema string for querying sms_messages_outbound and sms_campaign tables and handles row-to-object mapping, including status enumeration conversion.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SmsMapper instance after construction.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string used for querying SmsData.

methods.name: tableName
methods.description: Returns the main table name used in SQL queries.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row from the ResultSet to an SmsData object, extracting fields and converting status enum to data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all SMS messages from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single SMS message by its ID; throws SmsNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves all pending SMS messages, optionally limited.

methods.name: retrieveAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves all sent SMS messages, optionally limited.

methods.name: retrieveExternalIdsOfAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all sent SMS messages, optionally limited.

methods.name: retrieveAllWaitingForDeliveryReport
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of messages waiting for delivery reports with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all pending messages, optionally limited.

methods.name: retrieveAllDelivered
methods.description: Retrieves all delivered SMS messages, optionally limited.

methods.name: retrieveAllFailed
methods.description: Retrieves all failed SMS messages, optionally limited.

methods.name: retrieveSmsByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves SMS messages filtered by campaign ID, status, date range, with pagination, sorting, and limits applied.
